graded_findings.rationale: The new CLI source file changes the repository structure, but the generated repository index still omits it. That makes the shared AI context stale for a touched module and should be fixed before merge.

  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
  publish("safeoutputs/noop", "Docs judge evidence written; no GitHub issue required.")
}
